$comment: Dystopia: one branch (master); any subagent commits its own step wherever it works; only the pusher agent, which the push cards start fresh, pushes; the main session may too. Delegation slows at 80% and stops at 90%.

usage.holdAdvice: Do not start new subagents. Let in-flight agents finish and commit, then report.
usage.denyAdvice: Stop all work; commit what is green and end the turn.
